note: The script asks for four graphics: the hook text, Freddy's name super, the “English classes · Mondays” card and the “Bilingual volunteers needed · once a month” card. Every other row is captions only.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: MY STUDENTS WERE IN THE LINE

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “MY STUDENTS WERE IN THE LINE”. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Hook text over his face from frame 1. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:10.

mg.title: Freddy name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:11, lower left, 3 seconds: “Pastor Freddy Portales” / “Dream Center Dallas”.
mg.use: Name super at 00:11 for 3 seconds. Move it lower left, above the captions. Its second line is “Dream Center Dallas”. Check it spells Portales.

mg.title: English classes card
mg.use: Show it for this whole row, 00:11 to 00:16, near the top of the frame, above the name super.

mg.title: Bilingual volunteers card

text.main: Bilingual volunteers needed · once a month

mg.cue: Card at “bilingual volunteers”: “Bilingual volunteers needed · once a month”.
mg.use: Put it on at the words “bilingual volunteers”, top third. Hold it until 00:58, the end of the row.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: No logo before the end card.
mg.src: Dream Center Dallas has not sent its logo yet; the name is typed until Nick sends it, as the script says.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:58 after the last line and hold it to the end.
